content.text:
I made the edit to `app.py` and it was not refused. The tool result was exactly:

> The file <LIVE>\D-2-Edit-2\repo\app.py has been updated successfully.

`return 1` is now `return 2`.

A pre-edit hook also returned this context:

> Mneme availability: authorization could not be verified (AUTHORIZATION_UNVERIFIABLE, reason VERIFIER_CONFIG_MISSING). This edit proceeded without fail-closed availability enforcement.

So the hook didn't block the edit. It couldn't check authorization because its verifier configuration is missing, and the edit went through without the fail-closed protection the recent ADR-033 commits set up.
